Name: Little Raptors and small dinosaur egg
Author: TinCanRaccoon
Description:
Based on an old xnb edit I made, now updated to use Content Patcher.

Can be modified to support seasonal variants, comes with several alternate colour files both with back spikes and without.

This mod edits the size and description of the Dinosaur Egg as well. No config 'cause I'm lazy but the changes can be deleted from content.json if you want to keep the eggs massive.

[color=#93c47d][size=4][font=Arial][size=3]Now also available as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13648/]an Alternative Textures version[/url]﻿, many thanks to Purple Chickadee for handling the conversion![/size][/font][/size][/color]

[size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to function.[/size] Simply unzip and drop into your Mods folder!

You are free to modify the contents and recolour the sprites as long as you credit this page as the original.

Downloads.Description: Just unzip and toss into your Mods folder! Requires ContentPatcher.
